features.quote: a turn limit (default 25, per-task overridable). The loop ends on submit, turn limit, repeated no-op, or error.
features.justification_quote: Unbounded loops are impractical and costly, and "keeps going forever" is itself a degradation signal

features.quote: the run ends as `gave_up` (with one nudge in between)
features.justification_quote: treat persistent inaction as a (recorded) soft give-up rather than letting it silently consume the whole turn budget
